records.scope: First five guide entries, six numbered parts: selected-profile appearance review, introductory supporting profiles and original/ABC pilot distinction. No release-date or edition expansion.
limitations: The first five season-one guide entries (six numbered parts) have episode reviews against 46 selected profiles using named official text evidence. Omitted connections remain unestablished, not absent. This is not a full scene or cast census; the other 61 guide entries await selected-profile appearance review.

The combined Spark of Rebellion guide remains one review for parts 1–2. The later ABC Vader opening is excluded from original-pilot connections and remains a distinct documented version. No scene is assigned to an individual pilot part without evidence.

Obi-Wan’s holocron message, Trayvis’s broadcast and Luminara’s projected bait are transmissions. Luminara’s remains are also shown. Remote contacts followed by physical scenes use a single direct row with context; mentions, aliases and repeated names are not extra characters.

The original Phantom, later Phantom II, an individual stolen TIE fighter and the generic legacy TIE/LN type are not conflated. Exact unnamed ship models, other scenes, complete credits and technical specifications remain unreviewed.
Episode inventory and writing credits do not establish every language mix, supplied master or frame-level version. Public references are not open media licences.

Normalized count: 75 numbered parts across four seasons (15/22/22/16), grouped into 66 official guide entries (14/20/19/13). This is an archive counting convention, not a universal count of playable streaming items. The four introductory shorts and the ABC revised pilot are excluded. Individual credits and appearances within combined parts are not inferred.

Current release-date research is restricted to the original US launch of each work and, when necessary to distinguish a documented version, its first US release. Existing sourced events are retained. Worldwide/Finland dates, later platform availability, routine rereleases and exhaustive master comparisons are deferred rather than factually resolved.

episodeReviews.scope: One official guide entry reviewed against 46 selected profiles using named narrative caption evidence. Omitted connections remain unestablished, not absent. Spark of Rebellion covers two numbered parts together, excluding the later ABC opening.
notes: The gallery’s first item is the Vader/Inquisitor scene added for the later ABC presentation; it is not an original-pilot appearance. The contemporary ABC announcement establishes that distinction. The original ending’s Inquisitor contact and Obi-Wan’s holocron message are transmissions, not physical meetings.

One combined guide entry covers numbered parts 1–2. Connections are not assigned to individual parts without separate evidence. Tarkintown is a place name, not a Tarkin appearance. The Wookiees are on Kessel, not proof of a Kashyyyk setting. Individual Imperial capital ships and speeder models remain unestablished.

notes: Trayvis appears in a broadcast and Luminara as a projected recording used as bait. The coffin also holds her remains: this is neither a rescue of a living Luminara nor a Force spirit. The Grand Inquisitor physically confronts Kanan. Yoda is quoted in training, not shown.

The world identity is established by the Stygeon Prime Databank profile together with the gallery’s Spire mission. Lothal is a separate return setting. The Phantom is the original shuttle; no later Phantom II identity is inherited. The Spire’s Clone Wars backstory does not add Maul or Sidious to this episode.
